moworks.notes: Card drops in y −60 → 0 px on a spring (k 170, c 18: 5 % overshoot, ~500 ms); its shadow lands 50 ms later, title bar 60 ms, two text lines 100 / 140 ms, all on the same spring (recipe: parent 600 ms power2.out, shadow +40, title +80, subtitle +120 ms).
